allocation_basis: Internal authoring allocation across Snowflake-published top-level certification abilities. These counts are NOT claimed to be official exam weights. Reweight only when a current Snowflake-owned study guide provides an authoritative domain weighting.

freshness_policy.note: Release-aware content may use fewer than 750 items. Preview features must be labeled and must map to a locked objective. Durable documentation-grounded content remains the majority.

quality_mix.note: Question-type distribution varies by exam role; do not force irrelevant SQL or architecture formats merely to satisfy a quota.
